Vulnerabilities.Title: requests: Redirect to 301/302 sends Authorization header to third-party host
Vulnerabilities.Description: The Requests package before 2.20.0 for Python sends HTTP Authorization headers to an untrusted destination when redirected.

Vulnerabilities.Title: urllib3: TLS certificate validation bypass via specially crafted cert
Vulnerabilities.Description: The urllib3 package before 1.24.2 handles cert verification improperly when using ssl_match_hostname.
